description: Parcs de stationnement - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data Orléans Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Liste des parcs de stationnement d'Orléans Métropole (parkings, parkings relais bus et parkings relais tram), avec mention des places disponibles en temps réel pour les parcs équipés d'un système de contrôle d'accès. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are stationnement. The portal shows 31 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-orleans-metropole-fr-portal.
